evidence: Molybdenum hexacarbonyl [Mo(CO) 6] and ozone (O 3) were employed as the Mo- and O-source precursors, respectively. The Mo(CO) 6 precursor was vaporized in a stainless steel cylinder setting at 70 /C176C, carried by pure nitrogen (99.999%), and fed through an inlet at the front edge of the circular deposition area (5-in. diameter).
